versions: version ordinals 1,2,3 stand for 1.0.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0; module m is slot 'top', dependencies d/d1 are 'dep1', d2 is 'dep2'
observation_notes: history.* are %IPM_General.History rows for the action (load of m, load of each dependency); history_temp.* are ^IRIS.Temp.HistoryTempD rows left over; modules.*.manifest_present is %IPM.Storage.Module:NameExists; resources_loaded is a class resource of the module present; zpm_document_version is the .ZPM ModuleStream; writes counts module record writes (not natively comparable, LastUpdated changes); id_order is the History ID allocation order (gaps reveal rolled-back inserts)
